newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Peace Hill sees shift in control.
newsitem.headline: Peace Hill sees shift in control.

text.p: Peace Hill Enterprise Group Ltd said on Friday its controlling shareholder Red Hill Co Ltd had agreed to sell an option to take its entire 43.11 million share or 67.22 percent stake in Peace Hill to third party Kong Fa Holding Ltd for HK$174.77 million.
Red Hill is a wholly-owned unit of Peace Hill Enterprise (Holding) Co Ltd which is 75 percent controlled by Peace Hill's chairman Tsoi Yick Ying and 25 percent by his wife.
Kong Fa is wholly-owned by Kong Look Sen, the managing director and the founder of Malaysia-incorporated property and infrastrucutre concern Kong Sun Enterprise SDN.
Kong Fa will be required to make a general offer for all the shares of Peace Hill at a price of about HK$4.054 per share if the option is exercised following completion of the deal on November 29.
Shares of Peace Hill were untraded at HK$3.775 on Friday morning after they resumed trading following a three day suspension.
